Auditor independently re-implemented F4 arithmetic and verified: (i) system multiplicities via affine-translation local expansion (distinct code path from replay matrix substitution) match claimed 2,2,2,1,1,1 for S1-S4 and 3,1,1,1,1 for DJ rational points, so min-over-basis equals min-over-net is exact; (ii) no fixed F4-line for any rep (restriction binary quartic vanishes on 5 collinear F4-points iff identically zero; none do); (iii) primitivity (no common plane divisor of any degree >=1): found explicit F4-lines with trivial homogeneous GCD for every f and g (S1F 4/21 e.g. X+Y+Z=0, S2F 3/21, S3F 4/21, S4F 6/21, DJF 5/21 and similarly 5-9/21 for inverses), checking all monic linear, quadratic and cubic divisors plus t-divisibility and quartic proportionality, so any hypothetical common divisor C would restrict to a common divisor on the witness line, contradiction; this closes the gap in DRAFT section 3(ii) which asserted any F4-curve contributes >=17 F16-points (true for lines/smooth conics but false in general for higher-degree curves: smooth plane cubics over F16 have >=9 points, quartics can have few points, e.g. Galois-conjugate line unions), and the limitation note already flags the F16-count argument as non-general; conclusion (no fixed component, exact degree 4) nevertheless holds via the line-GCD witnesses. Composition check Zg0-Xg2=0, Zg1-Yg2=0 plus X/Y/Z divisibility with equal quotients phi!=0 proves g(f)=phi*id and f(g)=psi*id as polynomial identities (degree-16 compositions, degree-17 checks, 2x171 conditions), hence mutually inverse rational maps; with primitivity this gives birationality, inverse degree 4, and irreducible general member. Noether saturation then closes proper plus infinitely-near locus: exhibited proper multiplicities already square-sum to 15 (symmetric 3*4+3*1=15; DJ 9+6=15 including F16-pair lower bound >=1 each, forced to exactly 1 since total is 15 for a quartic Cremona), so no further proper (including F64 degree-3) or infinitely-near point is possible; tangent-cone spot checks are consistent but not load-bearing. Stabilizer sizes verified: monomial stabilizer of coordinate triangle 6*9=54; point stabilizer 180*16*3/3=2880; orbit enumerations recomputed and sums verified (84=C(9,3) symmetric triples; 1280=5*256 DJ quadruples). S1-S4 canonical forms under 54-element stabilizer are four distinct values, degenerate triple has fifth value with fixed line X+Y=0 containing double [0:0:1] plus three singles (2+3=5>4), so at least 4 symmetric classes; distinct homaloidal types separate DJ from symmetric. DJ pair verified: F16=F4[u]/(u^2+u+w), Frobenius (a0+a1u)->(a0+a1)+a1u order 2, P=[1:3u:1] and Q=[1:3+3u:1] are distinct non-F4 conjugates, both common zeros, directions (1:alpha) distinct from four rational directions, six distinct total; fully rational (4;3,1^6) with no fixed line is impossible since 6 distinct directions needed but P1(F4) has 5. DJ pencil covariance verified on all five F4-lines through [0:0:1]: four lines joining centre to rational singles contract to points, free direction (1:w^2) maps dominantly onto line 2X+3Y+Z=0 through [1:0:w]; DRAFT honestly states covariance p->q rather than strict invariance, which suffices as Jonquieres-type witness together with (4;3,1^6) datum. Proof (exact polynomial identities, finite enumerations, GCD witnesses) is distinguished from experimental evidence (orbit-size heuristics, 15360/122880 raw DJ counts explicitly left unreduced).

originality.rationale: Live literature retrieval (arXiv API + DOI publisher page, 2026-09-07) finds only disjoint neighbours, no prior degree-4 over F4 conjugacy census with normal forms, Galois base-point data and composition-inverse certificates. Calabri-Nguyen cubic fine classification (closed field, 39pp, type (3;2,1^4)) gives no finite-field Galois refinement or F4 quartic representatives. Schneider F2 generators (three infinite families plus small-base-orbit maps, generalized partly beyond F2) proves generation/involution over F2, no complete degree-4 class table over F4. Asgarli-Lai-Nakahara-Zimmermann bijective Cremona parity (no odd permutation over non-prime char-2 fields) is a high-level parity theorem with generator lists, no homaloidal census or base-point multiplicities. Genevois-Lonjou-Urech Neretin embedding plus even-permutation for q>=4 even and regularisation is general structure, no explicit quartic representatives or de Jonquieres-vs-symmetric distinction for F4. Alberich-Carraminana LNM homaloidal-curves chapter gives characteristic-0 homaloidal tables/Noether equations with no Fq-conjugacy or computational inverses. arXiv homaloidal query (23 hits) returns only polar/determinantal/ML-degree homaloidal hypersurfaces, no plane quarto-quartic Fq census. Choosing degree-4 over F4 is not parameter substitution: it is the minimal stratum where both homaloidal types coexist with char-2 Frobenius degenerations (orbit sizes 1,2,3,4,6, infinitely-near collisions, even-parity constraint) changing linear conditions and conjugacy; method requires char-2 blowup handling. No timestamp, memory or failed search was used to establish priority.

value.rationale: Fallback-level partial theorem is independently worth finding later and citable: first explicit plane Cremona maps of degree 4 over F4 (four symmetric fully-rational (4;2^3,1^3) plus one de Jonquieres (4;3,1^6) with F16-pair), each with normalized quartic triple, exact Galois degree-multiplicity datum saturating Noether equations, quartic inverse with two-sided symbolic composition certificate (common degree-15 cofactor), and type witness, all replayable in pure-Python stdlib in seconds. Configuration-level censuses (5 symmetric-triple orbits with 4 realised +1 fixed-line degenerate; 3 DJ rational-quadruple orbits) give tightened lower bounds (at least 5 PGL3(F4)-classes) and explicit upper bounds on the studied families, with full census number N explicitly left open and basis-splitting/non-rational patterns honestly listed as not exhausted. This is not a textbook restatement (Hudson/Noether equations are textbook, but Galois-orbit refinement, PGL3(F4)-reduction and inverse certificates for F4 quartics appear in none of the sources), not mere parameter substitution (see originality), not a tiny unmotivated gain (first closed data for the 3-4/F4-F5-F8 region, usable for finite-geometry catalogs, multivariate-crypto birational benchmarks and concrete even-parity witnesses), and not an unexplained enumeration (every representative carries Noether check, Galois datum, composition verification and witness). DRAFT scope is honest about what is not claimed.

sources.title: Generators of the plane Cremona group over the field with two elements - Schneider

sources.title: Bijective Cremona transformations of the plane - Asgarli, Lai, Nakahara, Zimmermann
sources.comparison: Studies permutations induced on rational points and proves no odd permutation over non-prime characteristic-2 fields via parity invariance and generator lists; high-level parity theorem with no degree-4 homaloidal census, base-point multiplicity data, or explicit F4 maps.
